data.choice: Retain the established S13 timing and causal sequence, but replace r7 output frames [16794,16854) with a static 640 by 360 crop from the clean native Node-RED editor capture, scaled to the 1280 by 720 episode frame.
data.reason: The closer native view identifies the actual tool and makes the two relevant nodes readable at delivery size without fabricating vendor UI, implying a new provider execution, or changing the locked narration.

alternatives.choice: Keep the wider native workflow view throughout the request beat.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: It establishes the tool but leaves the relevant node labels too small at phone review size.

alternatives.choice: Add a custom explanatory overlay instead of enlarging the native surface.

reuse.applies_when: A named workflow tool is part of the claim and its decisive control or state is unreadable at the intended delivery size.
reuse.avoid_when: A native surface is unavailable, sensitive, misleading, or would imply an execution or result that did not occur.
